name: firecrawl
description: Firecrawl agent skills for integrating scrape, search, interact, and related APIs into product code, plus the official Firecrawl MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Agent skills that teach coding agents how to integrate Firecrawl into application code (SDK and REST), covering onboarding, scrape, search, interact, and endpoint selection. Bundles the official firecrawl-mcp server so agents can also call Firecrawl tools directly when FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is set.
defaultPrompt: Add Firecrawl scrape to this project and verify a sample URL returns markdown.
Wire Firecrawl search into this app so it can discover pages before scraping.
Set up FIRECRAWL_API_KEY and install the Firecrawl SDK for this stack.
